title: 7 Best Herbal Tinctures For Inflamed Gums
description: Calendula officinalis tinctures have been traditionally used to treat inflamed gums due to their anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to reduce swelling and combat bacterial infections that cause the ailment. The bioactive constituents of Calendula officinalis, including triterpene saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, work together to promote wound healing and reduce pain in the gums.
